cards.title: Main Rail
items: Five ordered phases from Draft to Published
Under Review is the only decision point
Archived closes the record after the retention period

cards.title: Wait States
items: Submitted waits for a reviewer under a 72h SLA
Scheduled holds an approved document until its publish time
A failed publish job gets exactly one automatic retry

cards.title: Loops and Exits
items: Changes Requested returns the document to Draft for rework
Rejected is a reviewer decision; Withdrawn is an author decision
Withdrawn is reachable from Submitted or Under Review
